flows.description: Authentication, session persistence, logout, and role enforcement
Create or select a quiz, answer it, submit it, and observe the result
A new learner sees the starter quiz block on the dashboard and opens question 1 from it
Upload learning material, observe processing, and open the generated result
Start a subscription payment and verify success and cancellation outcomes
Enforce admin access and complete a representative administration action
Admin disable/restore: session revocation via authVersion, filter listing, and fresh login after restore
Admin makes a public quiz private (hidden from anonymous play and the public list), the change is audited, and it is reverted
Anonymous and non-admin callers are refused the test-account route; admin marks and clears the analytics test-account flag from /admin/users, and each change is audited with the actor
Admin opens the Personalized Learning stats workspace, sees aggregate totals and the trend chart, and each window filter refetches its own figures
Anonymous visitors are sent to login and non-admins to the dashboard from /admin/stats, and the personal-learning summary API answers 401/403
